_comment_agent: Activates agents/orchestrator.md as the main-thread agent for plugin consumers. Requires Claude Code >= 2.1.117. Users opt out by overriding in their own ~/.claude/settings.json with {"agent": null} (or removing the agent setting). NOTE: the BLITZ_DISABLE_ORCHESTRATOR env var is not currently honored by any blitz hook — use the settings override. Slash commands (/blitz:*) bypass the orchestrator and route directly to the named skill.
